text:
Aisha Khan: hey team, tiny panic before first week 1. My spouse is on my US benefits plan per offer letter but I havent been able to upload partner documentation. The benefits portal keeps rejecting the PDF (says file invalid). Is there an alternate upload? Also I have a one-time relocation allowance we agreed on. Do I need to submit receipts for the stipend or is that paid gross? Finally, my start date is the 1st of month but that day is a company holiday; will my PTO accrual start the following business day?

Maya (People Ops): hi Aisha, welcome! :wave: For partner docs: the portal sometimes rejects combined PDFs with embedded fonts. Try printing to PDF again ("Save as PDF" from Preview/Chrome) or split into two files (marriage cert + utility bill). If still fails email benefits@redwood.com and attach the files; we'll upload manually and confirm.

Maya (People Ops): relocation stipend: depends on the offer language. If it was a one-time lump-sum stipend (not expense-based) we pay it as a gross payment on your first payroll run; no receipts required. If it was "reimbursement" you must submit receipts. Check your offer email or ping me and Ill confirm.

Sam (Payroll): Aisha 1: if the stipend is grossed, itll show on the paycheck as "Relocation Stipend" and be subject to regular tax withholdings. If reimbursement, it may be net depending on classification. On the holiday + PTO: accrual policy is measured from start date. If the start date is a holiday we treat the start date as the effective date for benefits and PTO accrual; you will get prorated days based on that date.

Aisha Khan: awesome. Offer says "relocation allowance of $3,000 paid as a lump sum" so sounds like gross. One more oddity: my bank required an address to set up direct deposit and I gave my temporary address; payroll flagged that the address country doesn't match my bank country. Is that going to delay deposit?

Sam (Payroll): as long as bank routing and account match, deposit usually succeeds. If the bank rejects it then we reissue a physical check, which delays payout. If you want to avoid that, DM me a bank letter or screenshot confirming account and routing details and I can pre-validate. Also ensure your bank currency is USD for domestic accounts; cross-border banks sometimes reject.
